readout_other: 3-back working memory task (correct rejection rate, error false alarm rate, sensitivity d'); side-effects questionnaire
direction_notes: U-taVNS showed a similar directional trend to E-taVNS across working memory performance measures (d', correct rejection rate) but active vs sham differences did not reach statistical significance (e.g. d' ratio: t(28)=0.50, p=0.619). Post-hoc pre-to-post comparisons within the active U-taVNS condition showed significant increases in d' and overall accuracy, but a similar pattern was seen in the U-taVNS sham condition.
safety_notes: A higher proportion of participants receiving E-taVNS reported skin irritation compared to U-taVNS (E-taVNS: 20.0%; U-taVNS: 3.4%; chi2=3.86, p=0.049); ear pain was reported by both groups (E-taVNS: 16.7%; U-taVNS: 10.3%) with no significant difference between modalities.

timing.protocol_description: Participants received 30 minutes of taVNS per session; each participant completed two sessions (one active, one sham) separated by at least five days, with session order counterbalanced. flags.reason: 29 participants were allocated to U-taVNS, but one female participant was excluded from analysis for missing sham-session data ('Due to missing data from Sham session, one female participant from U-taVNS was excluded from the analysis'; 'Therefore, a total of 58 participants were analyzed, 30 for E-taVNS and 28 for U-taVNS.'); n_subjects reflects the enrolled/allocated total (29) rather than the analysed total (28).
The paper labels this 1.03 MPa value 'average intensity', though MPa is a pressure unit not an intensity unit; recorded as pressure_kpa (1030 kPa) rather than an intensity field.
'Peak mechanical output of 0.081 W/cm2' is not explicitly labelled ISPPA or ISPTA; assigned to ISPPA given the word 'peak', but this is an inference.
Duty cycle (50%) and PRF (41 Hz) are stated but pulse duration is not; not computed per the no-arithmetic rule.
The paper does not state whether the reported pressure/intensity values are free-field or in-situ; recorded under unspecified_domain.
